goal: Inject photo daily summaries as timeline day notes, deploy to Pixel 8, check APK code for note rendering, and produce 10-screenshot report

steps.description: Reverse engineer decompiled APKs to determine if Google Maps Timeline still has code/viewholders to render notes and identify protobuf wire format
Extract photo daily summaries and inject notes into timeline database and odlh protobufs
Deploy reconstructed timeline with notes to Pixel 8
Capture 10 on-device screenshots of days with notes and compile detailed report
